markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [2 max] print queue (serving requests on a shared printer) / spooling in printer; CPU task scheduling; handling of interrupts (in the same order as they arrive); buffer for devices like keyboard; queues in routers/ switches; mail queues; simulation/ computer modelling of physical queues (e.g., a customer waiting line in a supermarket queue, a call centre where technical personnel take calls and provide service, etc.); handling website traffic/ network congestion; maintaining playlist in media player; Note: Accept other appropriate examples of applications of queues in computing.
